description: Roles render as C-suite / department heads (CEO/CTO/CMO/CFO/CHRO/...). Roles without corporateName are SKIPPED — they're absorbed into a peer C-suite at this scale.

tagline.zh: 在大型组织里,每个 agent 代表整个职能部门
tagline.en: Each agent represents a whole function/department

renameMapping.rule: If role.corporateName exists, render using corporateName; otherwise skip the role entirely.
renameMapping.rationale: Large org doesn't want 1 AI agent per individual role — it wants 1 AI agent per function. Engineer is absorbed into CTO. Designer absorbed into CPO or marketing org.

q5Status: If Q5 lands on A (hardcode), this file IS the hardcode. If Q5 lands on B (workspace setting), add a user.metadata.preferCorporateNames flag that overrides renameRule per workspace. If Q5 lands on C (already current state), no change.
